provenance.section: Ticker Batch Channel — "it currently doesn't provide best bid or best ask fields"
modifications: product_id changed to ETH-USD so this fixture has its own top-of-book state and does not interact with the BTC-USD fixtures.

best_ask and best_ask_quantity keys are OMITTED. The documentation states that ticker_batch does not provide best bid or ask, and the AsyncAPI marks no ticker property required, so an absent top-of-book key is a shape the venue's own specification permits. Modelling it on the ticker channel keeps the fixture inside one channel's parser; no claim is made that the ticker channel is observed to omit them.

expectation: Parses. Produces one ReferenceTopOfBookChanged carrying bidPrice and bidSize only. An ABSENT key stays absent — it is never turned into "0" and never turned into an error. This is the documented-absence case; the empty-string case is a different fact and is rejected (see malformed-empty-best-bid).
